news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 am ET the same day.

news.headline: NeurAxis Files Form S-3 Resale Registration Statement
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an S-3 registering the resale of 1,923,194 shares of common stock by selling stockholders/directors (999,418 resale shares plus 923,776 shares underlying RSUs); the registration was subsequently amended and a Rule 424(b)(3) prospectus was filed to bring it effective, a technical process that creates potential future selling pressure but is not itself a capital raise.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock Dividend
news.summary: The Board approved a Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (approximately 80,463 shares at a $2.38 calculation rate) on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) results before market open with a call at 9:00 am ET, two days after this research cutoff. Q1 2026 showed 80% YoY revenue growth to $1.6M and 86.4% gross margin, so the market will watch whether that growth pace and margin trend held, and for an update on cash runway versus the ~$15M breakeven target.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company continues to add regional/national medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently 500k+ covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4, 2026), building on the Category I CPT code (effective Jan 1, 2026) that already unlocked over 50 million covered lives nationally.

catalysts.label: Cash-flow breakeven target
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to roughly $15M in annualized revenue needed for cash-flow breakeven, alongside a targeted burn rate of about $1M/quarter or less for the remainder of 2026.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) and VA channel ramp
catalysts.detail: Commercialization of the RED chronic-constipation device resumed alongside a new VA Federal Supply Schedule contract (effective Dec 2025, VA sales launched Jan 2026); management said on the Q1 2026 call that VA adoption was running ahead of initial expectations, making the pace of RED/VA revenue contribution a swing factor for 2026 growth.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results would be expected around mid-November 2026; no date has been officially announced yet.

pulse: NeurAxis is in a quiet holding pattern heading into its Q2 2026 print: no material company news has broken since the Aug 4 payer-coverage expansion, and the market's attention is squarely on the earnings release and call scheduled for August 11 (two days from today), which will show whether Q1's 80% YoY revenue growth and 86%+ gross margin held up. IB-Stim continues to add incremental payer coverage on top of the Category I CPT code that already opened 50M+ covered lives, while the RED device and new VA Federal Supply Schedule channel keep ramping. The July S-3 resale registration (now effective via a 424(b)(3) prospectus) remains a modest dilution/overhang factor alongside the existing ATM facility, even though no fresh capital raise has been announced.
